items.name: VioletsKey
items.title: Violet's Key
items.desc_en: She gave you this key to open a chest nearby, containing a reward for your deeds.

items.name: YordinsKey

items.desc_es: Te la dio para abrir la puerta de su sótano, en la parte trasera de su casa.

items.title: Yseult's Key

A rewarded key from the king's assistant.

items.desc_es: Una llave recompensada por la asistente del rey.\nHecha para abrir un cofre cerca de la cámara del rey.

items.desc_es: Abre el Salón de Baile de la Ciudadela por una puerta lateral.

_keys.note: The client ships 42 key sprites (Key0-Key41) but no per-key sprite assignment - keys are not ScriptableItems, they only exist as names in KeyTranslations. Every key therefore points at the generic cell; all 42 sprites are in the atlas (cells 480-521) ready to be assigned by hand.
